title: Google Sheets
description: Reads spreadsheet tabs and ranges, overwrites ranges and appends rows with the org's bound Google account. The add-on calls the Sheets API; the token stays host-side.

permissions.reason: Call the Google Sheets API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the spreadsheet connection

descriptor.name: sheets
descriptor.title: Google Sheets tools
descriptor.description: List tabs, read ranges, overwrite ranges and append rows in Google Sheets

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List the tabs of a spreadsheet with sheetId, title and grid sizes. Use the tab title to build A1 ranges for the other tools.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read an A1 range from a spreadsheet as rows of values.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: write_range
tools.description: Overwrite an A1 range with rows of values. Values are parsed like user input, so formulas start with '='.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: append_rows
tools.description: Append rows after the last row of a table in a spreadsheet.

range.description: A1 range of the table, e.g. Sheet1!A:D

rows.description: Rows of cell values to append

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound
